faq.a: Adile is associated with the Arabic form عَادِلَة, whose core sense is adile; just, fair (feminine).

faq.q: What is the origin of Adile?
faq.a: Adile is associated with Arabic. Adile is the Turkish form of Arabic عَادِلَة (ʿĀdila), the feminine of عَادِل, meaning 'just, fair'.
Yes — the underlying form عَادِلَة is Arabic.
Adile can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Adile should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿĀdila is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Adile mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Adile is rendered عادلہ and carries the sense عادلہ، انصاف کرنے والی.

faq.q: What does Adile mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Adile is rendered عادله and carries the sense عادله، دادگر.
A romanized syllable approximation is a-di-le. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Adile?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Adile, adile. Script forms are عادله, عادلہ, عَادِلَة, आदिला.

faq.q: Is Adile a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
